title: console form link: a user without create right is offered a fillable create form on /forms/NAME, and learns of the refusal only on Submit
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect with a named location, class b, an out-of-scope finding from the #29019 os-dev report (6573044505, PR #29184), the half of #29019's Business reason that its brief left optional · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** In #29019's reproduction, a member with read but no create right opens a form link (`/_console/forms/NAME`), fills the whole form, and only on Submit learns that they may not create. After PR #29184 the refusal reads well, but the user has still lost their typing. The card asked that the console "ideally not offer a create form the caller cannot submit".

**Measured (dev's reading at PR #29184).**
- `/apps/APP/forms/NAME` renders under `ConsolePermissionsScope` (the pathless layout around `/home` and `/apps/APP/*` in `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`), which already holds `/me/permissions`.
- The app-less `/forms/NAME` route of the reproduction sits under `ProtectedRoute` alone, so knowing the create right there needs a new request.
- `/f/SLUG` is anonymous.
- Doing it on one route only would split the same form's behaviour by URL.

**Wanted.**
1. On both authenticated form routes, a caller without the create right sees a refusal state up front (the same localized sentence PR #29184 uses), not a fillable create form. An edit form follows the update right in the same way.
2. Pick one mechanism and name it in the PR body: move `/forms/NAME` under `ConsolePermissionsScope`, or read the object's permissions on that route. One request at most, and no change to `/f/SLUG`.
3. No metadata key, no server change.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`, size S. It runs after PR #29184 lands (same file).

**Dedupe.** Searched `FormPage create permission upfront` (0) and `forms route ConsolePermissionsScope` (0).

Links back: #29019, PR #29184.
